unread_leads.citation: Liu et al. Magn Reson Med 2016;75:1730-1735

unread_leads.citation: Dokumacı et al. Imaging Neurosci (Camb) 2025;3:IMAG.a.966

empty_cells: (a) Subcutaneous fat at 1.5 T: no exact T1/T2 read. Only a rounded abstract value, fat T1 = 0.3 s at 1.5 T (Duewell 1995, fat depot not named). Gold 2004 has the table but is closed.
(a) Fat T2 at 1.5 T: nothing read.
(a) Fat and marrow T2*: nothing found at 1.5, 3 or 7 T (one Europe PMC query; sources are fat-quantification papers without healthy reference values in the abstract).
(a)(b)(c) PD of fat, muscle and blood relative to water: nothing found at any field.
(b) Skeletal muscle at 1.5 T: only the rounded abstract T1 = 1 s (Duewell 1995). No T2 at 1.5 T read.
(b) Skeletal muscle T2*: found at 3 T only (Zuo 2012). Nothing readable at 1.5 T or 7 T.
(c) Arterial blood in vivo at 1.5 T and 7 T: nothing read. 1.5 T has only one pre-contrast blood T1 with the vessel not named (Sharma 2006). 7 T arterial is in vitro only (Rane 2013, 37 °C).
(c) Blood T2 at 1.5 T (arterial and venous): no record (calibration constants or 23 °C data only; see leads Langham 2018, Rodríguez-Soto 2018, Wright 1991, Spees 2001, Barth 1997).
(c) Arterial blood T2 in vivo at 3 T and 7 T: nothing read (TRUST gives venous T2 only; arterial T2 values found were bovine in vitro and were excluded).
(c) Blood T2*: no record at any field. Human blood T2* was found only in vitro at 23 °C at 1.5 T (Barth 1997: out of specification, see unread_leads).
(c) Measured Hct together with measured oxygenation for the in vivo blood values: not available in any in vivo source read (Yv values come from T2 calibrations).
(d) Brain lesions at 7 T: no readable values (Marshall 2025 has values in figures only).
(d) Brain lesions at 1.5 T: only water T2 by MRS in pediatric tumours (Carlin 2019). T1 of tumours, MS plaques, infarct at 1.5 T: sources exist (Kjaer 1991, Larsson 1988/1989) but are closed.
(d) Multiple sclerosis lesion T1 and T2 (any field): no readable values (AJNR full texts blocked). Only R2* estimates at 3 T (Elkady 2025).
(d) Infarct T1 and T2* (any field): nothing read. Infarct T2 found at 3 T only (Wang 2023).
(d) Lesion T2*: only MS lesions at 3 T. Lesion PD: only peritumoral edema/area of malignant glioma at 3 T (Blystad 2017, 2020).
(e) CSF T1 and T2 in vivo at 1.5 T: nothing read from a primary source.
(e) CSF T1 at 7 T: nothing read (Rooney 2007 closed).
(e) CSF T2* at 1.5, 3 and 7 T: nothing found (one Europe PMC query, no relevant hit).
(e) CSF PD: no measured value. CSF is the PD reference (= 1) in the PD papers read, so there is no independent measurement.
(f) T2* of white matter and gray matter at 1.5 T: nothing read (Peters 2007 closed; one more Europe PMC query gave no source).
(f) PD of white matter and gray matter at 1.5 T: FILLED from one source only (Sbaihat 2025, synthetic MRI, supplementary table).
(f) PD of white matter and gray matter at 7 T: nothing recorded. Dokumaci 2025 gives effective PD* scaled to an ASSUMED WM value of 0.69 (see unread_leads); Leroi 2020 is closed.

notes: Every quote was checked by script as an exact substring (after white-space normalisation) of the Europe PMC abstract text or of the PMC full-text XML converted to text. In table quotes the ' | ' marks are cell separators added by the XML-to-text conversion.

Citations: journal, year, volume, pages and DOI are from the Europe PMC copy of the PubMed record and were cross-checked against Crossref (all agree; Barth 1997 has no DOI). The PubMed metadata tool was not called for each record.
T1_sd / T2_sd / T2s_sd hold the error value as printed; the notes say if it is SD, SEM or not stated. Zuo 2012 values are SEM.
Records with converted_from_rate = true: Blystad 2017, Blystad 2020 (R1, R2), Elkady 2025 (R2*), Sbaihat 2025 (R1, R2).
Not repeated from human_invivo.json: Spijkerman 2017 CSF T2 at 3 T and 7 T; Rane 2013 and Zhang 2013 venous blood T1 in vivo at 7 T.
Blood records with condition 'ex vivo' are in vitro samples at 37 °C: Rane 2013 (7 T) only.
A quote that has ' [...] ' joins two verbatim pieces (for example a T1 table row and a T2 table row); each piece was verified separately.
For brain lesions the 'tissue' field holds the pathology in the words of the source; pathologies were not merged.
Sbaihat 2025 supplementary files were downloaded as a zip of .docx files and read as text only.

The deep gray matter rows of Sbaihat 2025 (putamen, caudate, thalamus, pallidum at 1.5 T) are outside the cells of this task; they were added because human_invivo.json lists T2 of deep gray matter and globus pallidus T1 at 1.5 T as empty.
